name: Hotel Zeppelin
positioning: Rock 'n' roll themed hotel on Post Street, two blocks from Union Square, celebrating San Francisco's counterculture roots
best_for: Music lovers who want rooms with vintage record players and band-themed design
Travelers who want a playful base near Union Square, Maiden Lane and Chinatown

facts.text: Hotel Zeppelin is at 545 Post Street, close to Union Square, Maiden Lane and Chinatown.
The hotel is two blocks from Union Square.
Hotel Zeppelin is the sister hotel to San Francisco's Hotel Zetta.
The hotel opened in early March 2016.
The hotel bills itself as a love letter to rebels and revolutionaries, mixing free-spirited energy, artistic soul and rock 'n' roll edge.
Rooms have eclectic touches such as vintage record players and crushed velvet pillows on the beds that recall the city's counterculture roots.
Bathrooms feature psychedelic wallpaper bearing the names of local bands, from the Grateful Dead to Green Day, in homage to the rock posters of the '60s and '70s.
The hotel has a game room with skeeball, shuffleboard and bingo.
The Game Room can host social events and receptions.
The PLS on Post bar serves retro-chic cocktails, craft brews and sangria, with a daily happy hour.
On-site dining serves coffee pick-me-ups as well as burgers and shakes.
Hotel Zeppelin was named in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards in 2018, 2019, 2021 and 2025.
